name: camphor (synthetic) + menthol (+)- + methyl salicylate
uses: Use For the temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles & joints associated with: arthritis strains simple backache bruises sprains
otcwarn: Do not use Do not use on wounds or damaged skin with a heating pad if you are allergic to any ingredients of this product Stop use or ask a doctor if rash, itching, or excessive skin irritation develops Condition worsens Symptoms persist for more than 7 days Symptoms clear up and occur again within a few days
